cards.text: Present perfect: have/has + past participle (bentuk ketiga: lost, finished, written). Dipakai jika kejadian di masa lalu punya hasil yang terasa sekarang.

examples.id: Dompet saya hilang (dan sekarang belum ketemu).

cards.trap: Untuk he/she/it pakai has, untuk I/you/we/they pakai have.

cards.text: Present perfect sering dipakai untuk menyampaikan kabar baru.

examples.en: Look! Somebody has broken the window.
The station is closed. There has been a fire.

cards.text: gone dan been berbeda: has gone to = pergi dan masih di sana; has been to = pernah pergi dan sudah kembali.

examples.id: Ani pergi ke Bali (sekarang masih di sana).
Ani pernah ke Bali (sekarang sudah pulang).

cards.text: just = baru saja, already = sudah (lebih cepat dari dugaan), yet = sampai sekarang (dipakai di kalimat tanya dan negatif, biasanya di akhir kalimat).

examples.en: Have you finished yet? / I haven't finished yet.

cards.trap: Past simple juga boleh di contoh-contoh ini, misalnya I just had lunch (Unit 7D).

questions.prompt: I can't open the door. I ___ (lose) my key.
questions.why: Kuncinya hilang dan sekarang masih belum ada, jadi present perfect: have + lost.

questions.prompt: Dimas isn't here. He ___ to the office.
questions.why: Dimas pergi dan sekarang masih di kantor, jadi has gone. Has been berarti sudah kembali.
just (baru saja) atau already (sudah) dipakai di antara have dan past participle.

questions.prompt: Susun pertanyaan: "Apakah kamu sudah menyelesaikan PR-mu?"
questions.answer: Have you finished your homework yet?
questions.why: Pertanyaan present perfect: Have + you + past participle. yet di akhir kalimat tanya.
Setelah has dipakai past participle. Bentuk ketiga go adalah gone, bukan went.

questions.prompt: Sinta ___ (not / reply) to my message yet.
questions.why: Negatif present perfect dengan yet: hasn't + past participle.

questions.prompt: Jodohkan kata kerja dengan past participle-nya.
questions.why: Present perfect memakai past participle (bentuk ketiga). Daftarnya ada di Appendix 1 buku.

questions.answer: I have already read this book
questions.why: Hasilnya terasa sekarang (saya tahu isinya), jadi present perfect: have read.
Dalam kalimat tanya yang menanyakan "sudah atau belum", pakai yet di akhir kalimat.

questions.prompt: Look! Someone has broke the window.
questions.answer: Look! Someone has broken the window.
questions.why: Setelah has dipakai past participle: broken, bukan broke.
